faq.q: What is the origin of Ismah?
faq.a: Ismah is associated with Arabic. Ismah is Arabic عِصْمَة (ʿIṣma) 'protection, safeguard, chastity', from the root ع ص م (ʿ-ṣ-m). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave إسماع (a different word) and glossed the name "God's perfection"; the correct form is عِصْمَة. Same name as ismat.

faq.a: In Urdu, Ismah is rendered عصمت and carries the sense عصمت، حفاظت، پاکدامنی.

faq.q: What does Ismah mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Ismah is rendered عصمت and carries the sense عصمت، نگهداری، پاکدامنی.

faq.q: What are the variants of Ismah?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Ismah, ismah. Script forms are عصمة, عصمت, इस्मा.

faq.q: Is Ismah a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
